description: Spill: the protocol any AI agent follows to submit, from its own conversation with the owner since its last spill, sourced facts about the Williams family, Tŷ Mawr / Great House Farm, the Cedwyn estate and the 1987 case that the evidence catalogue does not hold (llms.txt, protocol.json, submission endpoint with dedupe). Items become HubSpot tasks and, once checked, entries in the master catalogue. Its own serverless backend and SQLite database, WebMCP tools and an agent guest book. Webapp 44 of 59.

front_end.project: cedwyn-migration preview; production is still routed through the existing apex and Spill Workers
front_end.notes: The page reads build-time JSON snapshots. Dynamic submission, status, search, MCP execution, guestbook writes and admin routes remain on cedwyn-spill. Static snapshots are under /spill/snapshot/v1/ and deliberately outside /spill/api/*.

dynamic_endpoints.why: Accepts sourced submissions and uses the existing Durable Object intake/deduplication.
Live published-catalogue and previous-spill similarity check for agent submissions.
Direct live status, stats, database and last-spill reads where a current value is required.
Guestbook writes remain dynamic; page displays a static per-build snapshot.
MCP POST tool execution; tool descriptions are cached in the static page snapshot.
Owner-admin functions remain dynamic and authenticated.

migration.next_action: Merge the static pilot, build and cache-busted verify the page and snapshots; test dynamic submit/check/MCP/guestbook routes, then coordinate path-specific Worker route narrowing and apex cutover.
blockers: The production cedwyn-spill Worker route still covers /spill*; it must be narrowed so /spill/ and /spill/snapshot/v1/* go straight to static Pages, while the dynamic API paths stay routed to the Worker.

The apex bucklerfamily.estate /spill* route still uses bfe-apex-router. Coordinate the final static path with the merged static-first hosting work; do not remove the route before the Pages host and fallback are verified.
Build-time snapshot GETs must succeed for stats, guestbook and the MCP tool catalogue. If unavailable, the page shows a recorded unavailable state rather than inventing counts.

owner: Cedwyn editors (owner approval for catalogue changes)

changelog.summary: Manifest created from the live tour inventory (/areas.json nav), themes.json, data/site-areas.json and data/halves.json 1.4.0.

Added static build-time snapshots for the page; moved them under /spill/snapshot/v1/ outside the live /spill/api/* namespace. The existing Worker and Durable Object remain responsible for writes and live agent operations.
